page.title: Insights
page.description: Pass rate, failures, flaky cases, coverage by label and token use over time.

rangeProblem.title: Check the dates
rangeProblem.order: The start date is after the end date.
rangeProblem.tooLong: Pick a period of {{maxDays}} days or less.

summary.title: Summary
summary.emptyDescription: Runs, failures and gaps in the period show here. Pick a longer period or another sprint.

executors.title: Runs by executor
executors.empty: No runs started in this period.

gaps.title: How long gaps stay open
gaps.summary: {{opened}} raised · {{answered}} answered · mean time to answer: {{duration}}

labels.title: Coverage by label
labels.description: Today's cases per label, the share that is Ready and the share whose latest result passed.
labels.chart: Share Ready and share passed by label
labels.emptyDescription: Coverage by label shows once the project has test cases.

sprintCoverage.title: AC coverage per sprint
sprintCoverage.description: Today's coverage of the acceptance criteria of each sprint's stories.
sprintCoverage.emptyDescription: No sprint with acceptance criteria overlaps this period.

topFailing.title: Cases that fail most
topFailing.description: Failed or blocked results in the period, story runs and suite runs alike. A data-driven case counts once per run, with its worst iteration.
topFailing.emptyDescription: No case failed or was blocked in this period.

flaky.title: Flaky cases
flaky.description: Cases whose last results flip between passed and failed, or whose executors disagree.
flaky.emptyDescription: No case is flaky or disagreeing right now.

tokens.title: Tokens per Claude run
tokens.description: Tokens reported by the execution log of each run started in the period. Runs whose log reported no tokens are not counted.
tokens.emptyDescription: No run in this period sent an execution log with token counts.
